desc: NM shall not prohibit bus traffic with NM not being initialized
The NM shall be applicable to different types of communication systems which are in the scope of Autosar and support a bus sleep mode.
NM shall provide services to coordinate shutdown of NM-clusters independently of each other
It shall be possible to trigger the startup of all Nodes at any Point in Time
NM shall provide a service to request to keep the bus awake and a service to cancel this request.
NM shall put the communication controller into sleep mode if there is no bus communication
The NM shall provide the current state of NM
NM shall inform application when NM state changes occur.
The NM interface shall signal to the application that all other ECUs are ready to sleep.
There shall be a deterministic time from the point where all nodes agree to go to bus sleep to the point where bus is switched off.
NM shall perform communication system error handling for errors that have impact on the NM behavior.
NM shall provide a mechanism to limit its bus load.
On a properly configured SWS_CanNm_NA_00008 16 of 117 Document ID 13: AUTOSAR_SWS_CANNetworkManagement node, NM shall tolerate a loss of a predefined number of NM messages
The NM shall tolerate a time jitter of NM messages in one or more ECUs
The timing of NM shall be configurable.
Specific features of the Network Management shall be configurable
The Network Management algorithm shall allow any node to integrate into an already running NM cluster
The Network Management shall optionally provide a possibility to detect present nodes
The Network Management API shall be independent from the communication bus
The NM API shall optionally give the possibility to send user data
The NM API shall optionally give the possibility to get user data
The NM shall optionally set the local node identifier to the NM-message
The NM API shall give the possibility to read the source node identifier of the sender
Every node shall have a node identifier associated with it that is unique in the NM-cluster.
The NM interface shall signal to the application that at least one ECU is not ready to sleep anymore.
It shall be possible to configure the Network Management of a node so that it does not contribute to the cluster shutdown decision.
The NM shall give the possibility to enable or 17 of 117 Document ID 13: AUTOSAR_SWS_CANNetworkManagement disable the network management related communication configured for an active NM node
NM shall provide functionality which enables upper layers to control the sleep mode.
It shall be possible to group networks into NM Coordination Clusters
NM shall offer a generic possibility to run other NMs than the AUTOSAR-NMs
All AUTOSAR NM instances shall support the NM Coordinator functionality including Bus synchronization on demand
CanNm shall support Partial Networking on CAN
The NM Control Bit Vector shall contain a PNI (Partial Network Information) bit.
Nm shall implement a filter algorithm dropping all NM messages that are not relevant for the ECU
Nm shall provide a service which allows for instantaneous sending of NM messages.
The NM coordination shall support the coordination of nested sub-buses
NM shall provide functionality to start-up 18 of 117 Document ID 13: AUTOSAR_SWS_CANNetworkManagement without requesting the network.
The NM Coordinator shall be able to abort the coordinated shutdown
The NM Control Bit Vector shall contain a PN shutdown request bit.
The NM of the top-level PNC coordinator shall set the PN shutdown request bit if a least one PNC is released
NM shall forward requests for synchronized PNC shutdown
NM shall handle requests for synchronized PNC shutdown
Nm shall be able to propagate and evaluate the need for Partial Networking Learning (optional)
Nm shall be able to propagate and evaluate the need for synchronized PNC shutdown in the role of a top-level PNC coordinator or intermediate PNC coordinator (optional)
